title: Personal Checking: Relationship Balance basis for the ordinary maintenance fee waiver, the opening entry test and other rules
content:
## Scope

This rule states which Relationship Balance basis every Personal Checking rule uses, apart from two determinations that set out their own: the review of a monthly maintenance fee dated the current business day that the owner questions (the same-day waiver review), and the test applied when the owner asks to convert an account to Private Client Checking (the Private Client conversion test).

## Formal clause

Outside the same-day waiver review and the Private Client conversion test, every Personal Checking rule that speaks of a Relationship Balance keeps the one basis: the customer's deposit balances at PCB summed across checking, savings and certificate holdings in the customer's own name, taken at close of business on the measurement date.

## What that one basis sums

The Relationship Balance on this basis is the total, over the customer's holdings, of:

| Holding | Counted | Amount counted |
|---|---|---|
| Each checking account of the customer | When not closed and not charged off | Its ledger balance, a negative balance counting as zero |
| Each savings account of the customer | When not closed | Its current balance |
| Each certificate of deposit of the customer | When not closed | Its principal balance |
| Each mortgage loan of the customer | Only when the checking tier counts mortgage principal, and only in active, delinquent or forbearance status | Its principal balance |

It is taken at close of business on the measurement date: the statement cycle closing date for a waiver, and the date on which the request is handled for an entry test or a conversion.

## Where this basis applies (derived from the clause)

| Determination | Basis |
|---|---|
| Monthly maintenance fee Relationship Balance waiver judged at an ordinary statement cycle close | This one basis, at close of business on the cycle closing date |
| Private Client Checking entry test when a new account is opened | This one basis, on the date the request is handled |
| Same-day waiver review of a questioned maintenance fee | Not this basis; that review sets out its own |
| Private Client conversion test | Not this basis; that test sets out its own |

## Worked case (hypothetical customer, ordinary cycle close)

At close of business on a cycle closing date the customer holds two open checking accounts at 2100.00 USD and minus 40.00 USD, one active savings account at 6400.00 USD, one closed savings account, and one active certificate at 12000.00 USD, and the checking tier does not count mortgage principal. The Relationship Balance is 2100.00 plus 0.00 plus 6400.00 plus 12000.00, which is 20500.00 USD; the closed savings account adds nothing.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "since the single-basis clause was retired, the ordinary cycle-close waiver has no basis". **Correct basis:** outside the two determinations named above, every rule keeps the one basis stated here.
